# Devcontainer — Developer Environment

The devcontainer is for **internal development only** — it is not part of the
end-user experience. End users install plugins via `claude-kit update` and never
interact with the container.

## When to Use the Devcontainer

All development work (builds, tests, validation, CLI execution) should happen
inside the devcontainer. The container image is pre-built with every tool the
project needs.

```bash
# Create and start (from host)
.devcontainer/ctl.sh create

# Open a shell in the running container
.devcontainer/ctl.sh start
```

## Image and Registry

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Image | `ghcr.io/mateosegura/dev-env-claude-kit:latest` |
| Base | `ubuntu:24.04` |
| Dockerfile | `.devcontainer/Dockerfile` |
| Published by | `publish-devcontainer.yml` on pushes to main |
| Rebuild trigger | Changes to `.devcontainer/Dockerfile` or the workflow file |

The image is rebuilt and pushed automatically — you do not need to manually
build or push unless testing Dockerfile changes locally.

## Environment File

The container requires `.devcontainer/.env` with at minimum:

```
GITHUB_TOKEN=<personal access token>
IS_SANDBOX=1
```

Copy from `.env.example` if starting fresh. This file is **never committed**
(gitignored). The `IS_SANDBOX` flag is required and must be `1`.

## Lifecycle Hooks

`.devcontainer/ctl.sh` handles both host-side and container-side actions:

| Hook | When | What it does |
|------|------|-------------|
| `post-create` | Container first created | Symlinks `claude-kit` to `/usr/local/bin` |
| `post-start` | Every container start | Authenticates `gh` and `ghcr.io` via `GITHUB_TOKEN` |

## Mounts

| Source | Target | Purpose |
|--------|--------|---------|
| `~/.claude` | `/root/.claude` | Personal Claude config passthrough |
| `/var/run/docker.sock` | container socket | Docker-in-Docker via host daemon |
| `claude-kit-gomodcache` volume | `/go/pkg/mod` | Go module cache persistence |

## Pre-installed Tools

The image includes all runtime dependencies listed in the code style rule:
`python3`, `ruff`, `git`, `gh`, `jq`, `openssl`, `docker`, `node`, `go`,
`claude`, `ripgrep`, `fd`, `yq`, `hyperfine`, `zsh`.

VS Code extensions for Python (ruff), Go, ShellCheck, YAML, Docker, GitLens,
and Markdown are configured in `devcontainer.json`.

## Building Locally

Only needed when testing Dockerfile changes before pushing:

```bash
.devcontainer/ctl.sh build    # builds linux/amd64 locally
.devcontainer/ctl.sh push     # authenticates and pushes to ghcr.io
```

Once the Dockerfile change merges to main, `publish-devcontainer.yml` rebuilds
and pushes automatically.
